terms.ko: throws: 함수가 에러를 던질 수 있다는 표시
terms.definition: A keyword you add to a function to say that it can fail and send back an error.
terms.example: I marked the save function as throws, because writing to disk can fail.

terms.ko: try: 실패할 수 있는 함수를 호출할 때 앞에 붙이는 키워드
terms.definition: A keyword you write before a call to a function that can fail, to show you know it might send back an error.
terms.example: You need to put try before that call, otherwise the compiler will complain.

terms.definition: A statement that runs code that might fail and lets you handle the error if one happens.
terms.example: I wrapped the decoding in a do-catch, so a bad response will not crash the app.

dialogue.title: A failing save, in a code review
dialogue.setting: Maya reviews a pull request from her teammate Dev.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Hey Dev, quick question about your save function.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Writing to disk can fail, but the function is not marked as throws.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Good catch. I will add throws to the signature.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Then every caller needs to put try before the call.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right, otherwise the compiler will complain.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And please wrap it in a do-catch, so the app will not crash.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Done. I used try inside a do-catch and showed an alert.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Perfect. I will approve it now.
You need to put try before that call, otherwise the compiler will complain.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Will the app crash if the response is bad?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No, I wrapped it in a do-catch.
